_comment: Merge this fragment into your ~/.claude/settings.json under the top-level `hooks` key. The install.sh script will do this automatically.

hooks.command: P=$(jq -r '.prompt // empty'); ID=$(printf '%s' "$P" | sed -nE 's/^[[:space:]]*([Nn][Cc][Tt])?([0-9]{8})[[:space:]]*$/\2/p'); if [ -n "$ID" ]; then open "https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT$ID"; printf '{"decision":"block","systemMessage":"Opened https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT%s in browser"}' "$ID"; fi
